name: dark-media-landing-page
description: Dark-themed, media-rich AI tool landing page — scrolling media wall hero, bento capabilities grid, numbered how-it-works, and fullscreen video-background closing CTA.

slots.productName: Your product name — shown as eyebrow label
slots.accentColor: CSS custom property --accent-color (e.g. #F7C948 for amber, #a78bfa for violet)
slots.primaryColor: CSS custom property --primary-color for secondary accents
slots.tagline: Hero headline — two-part, second part in accent color
slots.audience: Audience line below headline (e.g. 'For creators & brand builders')
slots.heroMediaWall: Replace <hero-media-wall> with your scrolling media grid component
slots.bentoCards: 4 capability cards in the bento grid — customize headlines, descriptions, badge labels and border accent colors
slots.howItWorksSteps: 3 numbered steps explaining how the product works
slots.pipelineHeadline: Under the hood / AI pipeline section headline
slots.videoCtaPoster: Poster frame for the background video
